Affiliate resource guide (inline)

The Soft Life System — Affiliate Resource Guide

Monetization plan for the tools and books recommended to readers. The curated resource list lives on studio.gabochie.com — every link below should be registered to you, then placed on that page and in your emails/social posts. Never put affiliate links inside the book itself (Amazon KDP prohibits affiliate links in Kindle books, and in-book links can't be updated after print runs anyway).

Prepared Nov 11, 2026. Terms verified where marked ✅ (from official pages or multiple recent directories); unverified items marked ⚠️ — confirm on the program page before relying on the numbers.

How to use this guide

  1. Register for the Tier 1 programs first (best fit + easiest approval). Approval can take days to weeks, so start now.
  2. Build one page on studio.gabochie.com: "The Soft Life Stack — tools I actually use," with your affiliate links and a clear disclosure at the top.
  3. Each program pays through a different network. You'll need accounts on PartnerStack, Impact, Partnerize, CJ/Awin, and Dub — one signup each, then apply to individual programs from inside.
  4. Disclose on every page/post that contains a link (see disclosure templates at the end).

Tier 1 — Register first (best fit, easy approval)

Kit (formerly ConvertKit) — email marketing ✅

  • Commission: 50% of each referred customer's first 12 months; 10–20% recurring indefinitely after that if you refer 10+ paying customers/year (Bronze/Silver/Gold tiers)
  • Cookie: 90 days · Network: PartnerStack · Min. payout: $5 (PayPal/Stripe)
  • Apply: kit.com/affiliates
  • Why: The book's "Communicate" role. Creator-focused, matches the reader perfectly. ~$175–200 per conversion on the entry paid plan.

systeme.io — all-in-one funnels/email/courses ✅

  • Commission: 60% lifetime recurring, no application, no cap, free plan for referrals
  • Cookie: lifetime attribution · Network: in-house · Payouts: from $30
  • Apply: systeme.io/affiliate-program
  • Why: All-in-one budget tool (funnels + email + courses + automation). Very popular with African solopreneurs; strong fit for the book's "start simple" message. ~$10/mo recurring per referral at entry pricing — compounds over time.

Pabbly Connect — automation ✅

  • Commission: 30% recurring for the lifetime of the customer (20% flat on lifetime deals)
  • Cookie: 365 days · Network: in-house · Min. payout: $50 (PayPal / INR bank)
  • Apply: pabbly.com/affiliates
  • Why: The book's "automation engine" role at a budget price. Longest cookie in the category; open sign-up; India-based so INR payouts work. No paid-search ads allowed.

Make.com — automation ✅

  • Commission: 35% recurring for 12 months
  • Cookie: not published · Network: in-house · Approval: open sign-up
  • Why: The premium visual automation tool readers will graduate to from Pabbly.

FreshBooks — invoicing & accounting ✅

  • Commission: up to $200 per paying customer, up to $10 per free trial (starts ~$55 per sale, scales with volume)
  • Cookie: 120 days · Network: PartnerStack · Approval: manual review (they want original content aimed at freelancers/service businesses — this book qualifies)
  • Apply: freshbooks.com/affiliate-program
  • Why: The book's "Get paid" role. One-time but high-value; 120-day cookie is the longest in finance software.

ClickUp — projects & delivery ✅

  • Commission: up to $25 per free workspace signup (tiered perks at 100/200 signups/mo)
  • Cookie: 30 days · Network: in-house (clickup.com/affiliates) · Approval: easy
  • Why: The book's "Deliver" role. Free-signup bounty converts well from tutorial content.

Dubsado — client management ✅

  • Commission: $35 cash per referral who subscribes and stays 60 days; invite tiers reach $50/$75 · referral gets 20% off first month/year
  • Network: Dub (their new partner platform, launched Oct 2026)
  • Apply: app.dubsado.com/affiliate (needs a free Dubsado account)
  • Why: The "Capture → Deliver → Get paid" pipeline for service solopreneurs.

Canva — design ✅

  • Commission: up to $36 per new paid-plan signup
  • Network: in-house (Canva Partners / "Canvassador") · confirm current terms at canva.com before relying on the figure
  • Why: Readers will build their brand assets, lead magnets, and templates here.

Buffer — social media scheduling ✅

  • Commission: 25% recurring for 12 months per referred customer
  • Cookie: 90 days · Network: Dub (partners.dub.co/buffer/apply) · free to join, manual review (3–5 business days) · Payout: monthly via Dub
  • Why: Buffer is already named in the book's social media workflow — this turns that mention into income. Entry plans are $5/mo/channel, so it converts easily on creator-focused content.

Tier 2 — Strong fits, apply after Tier 1

beehiiv — newsletters ✅

  • Commission: up to 60% of a referral's first year
  • Why: For readers whose soft life is a newsletter business.

Flodesk — email design ⚠️

  • Commission: 50% of first year (verify current terms at flodesk.com/partners)

SavvyCal — scheduling ✅

  • Commission: 25% ongoing · Apply: via savvycal.com
  • Why: The scheduling pick for the resource page.

Cal.com — scheduling ✅

  • Commission: 20% recurring for 12 months (+ referred customer gets 20% off 12 months)
  • Network: in-house · Approval: required · Why: Developer-friendly Calendly alternative; good for technical readers.

Squarespace — websites & Acuity Scheduling ⚠️

  • Commission: ~10% per new subscription (Acuity pays a flat bounty per subscriber); runs on Impact. Verify exact terms after applying — they're visible post-approval.
  • Why: The book assumes a simple web presence; Acuity is the booking tool inside it.

HoneyBook — client management ✅

  • Commission: $50 per subscriber (one-time), 30-day cookie, paid after the member stays 100 days · referral gets 25% off
  • Caveat: Only available in US/CA/UK/AU — recommend only to readers in those markets; use Dubsado for the rest.

Wise — international payments ✅

  • Commission: ~£10–15 per qualifying personal referral (must complete a real transfer, not just sign up); ~£50 for business referrals; 1-year cookie
  • Network: Partnerize (wise.com/gb/affiliate-program)
  • Why: Highly relevant for African/Global South readers getting paid by international clients. A Wise account also saves YOU payout-conversion fees on other programs.

QuickBooks — accounting ✅

  • Commission: 10% per sale · Cookie: 45 days · Network: CJ
  • Why: For readers who outgrow invoicing-only tools.

Semrush — SEO/marketing ✅

  • Commission: $100–$300 per sale + $10 per trial · Cookie: 120 days · Network: Impact
  • Why: Chapter 10's "Quiet Growth Engine" — organic search content.

n8n — automation ✅

  • Commission: 30% recurring for 12 months
  • Network: in-house · Why: For technical readers who want self-hosted automation.

Africa / Ghana stack — verified programs

These are the picks to feature for readers in Ghana and across Africa. Several also pay through methods that work without PayPal (a real constraint for African affiliates).

Selar — sell digital products (Africa's creator commerce platform) ✅

  • Refer & Earn: 10% commission on every subscription payment a referred creator makes (recurring, no cap) + 20% annual commission if they join Selar's affiliate network; referred user gets 5% off. Requires your own active paid Selar/Affiliate plan.
  • Affiliate Network: a separate earner — promote 30,000+ African digital products for up to 70% per sale (NGN 3,000/year membership)
  • Network: in-house · Payouts: instant to Selar wallet, no minimum; supports Ghana cedis, NGN, USD, and mobile-money/bank payouts
  • Apply: selar.com (Refer & Earn is in your dashboard) · affiliates.selar.com (network)
  • Why: The African Gumroad. Readers use it to sell ebooks/courses/services with cards, bank transfer, and mobile money. Double opportunity for you: list The Soft Life System course/templates on Selar AND recruit affiliates to sell them — you earn from your own product sales while your referral links earn from their subscriptions.

Payoneer — get paid by international clients ✅

  • Commission: ~$25 per new customer who becomes active (directory-cited figure; Payoneer does not publish the rate — confirm at onboarding)
  • Cookie: 30 days · Network: PartnerStack / in-house · Payouts: monthly to your Payoneer balance or bank
  • Apply: payoneer.com/affiliate-program
  • Why: The standard for African freelancers receiving USD/GBP/EUR from global platforms and clients; withdraws to Ghanaian banks in GHS. A Wise alternative for readers without the documents Wise needs.

Fiverr — get clients / get work ✅

  • Commission: 25% of a new buyer's first order + 10% revenue share for 12 months; Fiverr Pro 70% of first order; Logo Maker $30 fixed
  • Network: in-house (fiverr.com/partnerships/affiliates) · Min. payout: $100, net-30 to bank (no PayPal required)
  • Why: Two-sided relevance: readers who need their first clients AND readers who sell services. Strong conversions from "how to start freelancing" content aimed at Africa.

Grey — virtual USD/GBP/EUR accounts ✅

  • Commission: $5 per referred user (both sides) after the referral deposits $500
  • Network: in-app "Affiliate & Referrals" — instant, no application
  • Why: Works in Ghana: GHS withdrawals, virtual dollar cards for paying for SaaS subscriptions (the single biggest blocker for African readers buying tools). Small bounty, but zero friction — every Ghanaian reader can promote it from day one.

Raenest (formerly Geegpay) — virtual dollar accounts ⚠️

  • Commission: $5 per successful referral (friend gets $2), capped at $152 total
  • Network: in-app referral · Verify current terms before featuring
  • Why: Nigeria/Kenya-focused alternative to Grey — feature for Nigerian readers.

Zoho — business suite (CRM, Books, Invoice, Forms) ✅

  • Commission: 15% of first-12-months revenue per qualified sale (18%/20% at Super/Elite tiers) · Cookie: 90 days · Min. payout: $100 (PayPal or wire)
  • Caveat: the referral must sign up in the same data center region you registered in — register in the DC matching your audience; commission is on the first product only
  • Apply: zoho.com/affiliate · referred customers get $100 wallet credit
  • Why: The affordable alternative to the whole Western stack: Zoho Invoice is free, Books handles accounting, Campaigns is email — all accepted across African markets.

Hostinger — websites & hosting ✅

  • Commission: up to 40% on qualifying 12-month+ initial purchases (AI Builder up to 60% via special offers) · Cookie: 30 days · Cap: $300/sale
  • Network: in-house + CJ · Apply: hostinger.com/affiliates or via CJ
  • Why: Cheapest credible hosting + domain for a Ghanaian solopreneur's first website; pays out internationally without PayPal problems.

Global tools that also serve Africa (already verified above)

  • systeme.io — popular with African solopreneurs; all-in-one at ~$10/mo
  • Pabbly Connect — India-based; INR payouts; lifetime deals suit low-budget readers
  • Canva — free tier is the design tool of record across Africa
  • Wise — works in Ghana for receiving/sending USD-GBP-EUR (complement to Grey/Payoneer)
  • Kit / beehiiv / ClickUp / Cal.com — free tiers work anywhere; PayPal payouts fine
  • FreshBooks / Dubsado / HoneyBook — Western-market readers only (HoneyBook: US/CA/UK/AU); keep out of the Africa/Ghana section

Note: Paystack, Flutterwave, and MTN MoMo have no affiliate programs, so under the affiliate-only rule they stay off the resource page — Selar and Zoho Invoice cover the "get paid locally" role instead.

The books (Further Reading section) — Amazon + Bookshop.org

The "Resources & Further Reading" list in the back matter names 12 books. Monetize it:

Amazon Associates

  • Apply: affiliate-program.amazon.com · Books pay ~4.5% (varies by category)
  • Rules: 24-hour cookie, strict disclosure + no link-spamming, must make 3 sales in 180 days to keep the account
  • Use: a single "See the full reading list" link on studio.gabochie.com (a storefront list of all 12 books) rather than links inside the book

Bookshop.org ✅

  • Commission: 10% per book (up to 15% enhanced program) · Attribution: 48 hours
  • Apply: bookshop.org/affiliates/profile
  • Why: Ethical angle fits the brand ("support independent bookstores"), and you can build a public storefront list of the 12 recommended books — link it from your site and your author email signature.

Disclosure templates

Website resource page (required by FTC; add at top of studio.gabochie.com/stack):

Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you sign up through them, I earn a commission at no extra cost to you. I only recommend tools I believe are worth your money — several are here even though they pay me nothing.

Email/social footer:

Disclaimer: links to tools may be affiliate links. Your price never changes.

KDP note: do not add these links or disclosures inside the ebook/print book — Amazon's Associates policy and KDP terms prohibit affiliate links in Kindle content. Keep the book pointing to studio.gabochie.com only.
